schema.name: customer_credit_sources
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE customer_credit_sources (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('RETURN_CREDIT','UNAPPLIED_CASH')),
  origin_payment_id INTEGER,
  origin_invoice_id INTEGER,
  credited_amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL,
  consumed_amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  refunded_amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  remaining_amount DECIMAL(15,2)
    GENERATED ALWAYS AS (ROUND(credited_amount-consumed_amount-refunded_amount,2)) VIRTUAL,
  refundable_cash_amount DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  credited_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  voided_at TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT c_nonneg_consumed CHECK (consumed_amount>=0),
  CONSTRAINT c_refund_le_credited CHECK (refunded_amount<=credited_amount),
  CONSTRAINT c_refundable_nonneg CHECK (refundable_cash_amount>=0),
  CONSTRAINT c_refundable_le_remaining CHECK (refundable_cash_amount<=remaining_amount)
)

schema.name: invoice_returns
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE invoice_returns (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    return_no       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,               -- RET-0926-00001
    invoice_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id),
    customer_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES customers(id),
    return_date     TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- user-pickable (spec D14)
    reason          TEXT,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Unsettled'
                    CHECK (status IN ('Unsettled', 'Settled', 'Voided')),
    fee_type        TEXT CHECK (fee_type IN ('none', 'fixed', 'percentage')),
    fee_value       REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,            -- 10 (percent) or 150 (fixed)
    fee_amount      REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,            -- resolved amount
    returned_amount REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,            -- tax-inclusive gross returned value
    net_amount      REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,            -- returned_amount − fee_amount
    settled_amount  REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,            -- Σ allocations (≤ net_amount)
    warehouse_id    INTEGER,                            -- restock warehouse
    created_by      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
    voided_at       TEXT,
    voided_by       INTEGER REFERENCES users(id),
    CHECK (fee_amount >= 0 AND returned_amount >= 0 AND settled_amount >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "payments" (

schema.name: journal_balance_delete
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER journal_balance_delete
AFTER DELETE ON journal_lines
BEGIN
  UPDATE journal_entry_balances
  SET balance_cents = balance_cents - CASE WHEN OLD.voided = 0
    THEN CAST(ROUND(OLD.debit * 100) - ROUND(OLD.credit * 100) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END
  WHERE journal_entry_id = OLD.journal_entry_id;
END

schema.name: journal_balance_insert
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER journal_balance_insert
AFTER INSERT ON journal_lines
BEGIN
  INSERT OR IGNORE INTO journal_balance_zero (value) VALUES (0);
  INSERT INTO journal_entry_balances (journal_entry_id, balance_cents)
  VALUES (NEW.journal_entry_id, CASE WHEN NEW.voided = 0
    THEN CAST(ROUND(NEW.debit * 100) - ROUND(NEW.credit * 100) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END)
  ON CONFLICT (journal_entry_id) DO UPDATE
    SET balance_cents = balance_cents + excluded.balance_cents;
END

schema.name: journal_balance_no_replace_insert
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER journal_balance_no_replace_insert
BEFORE INSERT ON journal_lines
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_lines WHERE id = NEW.id)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Journal lines must be updated, not replaced');
END

schema.name: journal_balance_no_replace_update
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER journal_balance_no_replace_update
BEFORE UPDATE OF id ON journal_lines
WHEN NEW.id != OLD.id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_lines WHERE id = NEW.id)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Journal lines must be updated, not replaced');
END

schema.name: journal_balance_update
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER journal_balance_update
AFTER UPDATE OF journal_entry_id, debit, credit, voided ON journal_lines
BEGIN
  UPDATE journal_entry_balances
  SET balance_cents = balance_cents - CASE WHEN OLD.voided = 0
    THEN CAST(ROUND(OLD.debit * 100) - ROUND(OLD.credit * 100) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END
  WHERE journal_entry_id = OLD.journal_entry_id;
  INSERT INTO journal_entry_balances (journal_entry_id, balance_cents)
  VALUES (NEW.journal_entry_id, CASE WHEN NEW.voided = 0
    THEN CAST(ROUND(NEW.debit * 100) - ROUND(NEW.credit * 100) AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END)
  ON CONFLICT (journal_entry_id) DO UPDATE
    SET balance_cents = balance_cents + excluded.balance_cents;
END
